template_name: Template B — Classic Magazine (colorful photo bg)

canvas.note: True TikTok full-bleed size. Every slide in the carousel must be exported at exactly this size.

primary.role: Bold = the yellow headline word/phrase on the thumbnail. Regular = all body/paragraph text on content slides.

accent.role: The second line of the thumbnail only — the softer, human, non-yellow line.

fonts.rule: Exactly two font families, three weights total (Outfit Regular, Outfit Bold, Crimson Pro Italic). Never add a third font.

colors.note: accent_yellow is used ONLY on the bold headline text. Everything else text-wise is ink_white. scrim_black is only used at low opacity for the cover vignette, never as a solid decorative shape.

background.fit_definition: Scale the photo to fill the 1080x1920 canvas (larger of width/height ratio), then center-crop. Sharp edges. No blur fill, no feathered photo edges.

vignette.purpose: Cover/thumbnail only. A soft, heavily-blurred dark ellipse sits behind the headline so yellow/white type stays readable.
vignette.shape: ellipse, width ~95% of canvas width, height ~46% of canvas height

body_card.purpose: Body slides only — not the thumbnail. Even clear glass around the paragraph (photo shows through, thin even rim, no wet highlight).

layout_rules.everything_centered: Both the headline block (poster slide) and the body text (content slides) are vertically AND horizontally centered on the 1080x1920 canvas.
layout_rules.no_decor: No eyebrow/label text, no divider lines, no page-number index, no swipe arrow/CTA text, no page dots. Cover: full-bleed photo, vignette, centered headline. Body: full-bleed photo, liquid-glass card, centered paragraph.

poster_thumbnail.stacking: bold block first, then italic block directly below with gap_after_bold_px, whole stack vertically centered as one unit

content_slide.stacking: glass card sized to the paragraph, then text on top, whole stack vertically centered
